Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 6  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that J. M. Barrie lived longer than Edward Albee, despite the lifespan calculations clearly showing that Edward Albee lived 88 years while J. M. Barrie lived 77 years. This error occurred due to a mix-up in interpreting the lifespan data provided by the WebSurfer. The Planner mistakenly swapped the lifespans, claiming J. M. Barrie lived longer, which led to the wrong solution to the real-world problem.
